description: Audit old submissions: the user has a CSV export of past form submissions (Webflow, Framer, HubSpot, Formspree, Netlify, Typeform or any tool). Parse it yourself and pass up to 200 rows; each is judged and you get a summary ("4 of 12 were pitches") and every row's verdict with the sentence that gave it away. With form_id the rows are imported into that form's inbox (source "audit": never forwarded, never counted as checks) so the user can check and rescue them; without it nothing is stored. Free, 3 audits an hour.

api_key.description: Doorman API key (dm_live_...). Only needed if the MCP connection has no Authorization header.

context.description: What the business sells, one line. Required unless the form has a site_context.

form_id.description: Optional f_...: import the judged rows into this form's inbox, judged against its context

kind.description: lead (default) for contact/demo forms; signup for a newsletter or waitlist export with no message column

rows.description: Rows parsed from the CSV export, newest first

fields.description: Up to 6 short extra columns (company, website, phone...)

received_at.description: The row's date from the export, as written

name: doorman_audit_rows
